Players Committee card image of [[It's True, All Of It]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “If opponent just played an Interrupt, use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack that card here. If opponent just drew destiny (or played an Interrupt) with the same card title as card here, they lose 1 Force. [Immune to Control.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/itstrueallofit.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/itstrueallofit.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
